equipment.name: Emergency Generator — Data Room
equipment.notes: Restricted — data room access required for physical inspection.

faultincidents.description: Severe vibration detected on pump shaft. Bearing failure suspected. Pump isolated.
Minor seal weep observed on stuffing box. Pump remains operational but requires attention.
Coolant leak from upper radiator hose. Generator taken offline for repair.
Fill media damage observed on two sections. Drift eliminator also cracked. Reduced cooling capacity.
Excessive oil carry-over in discharge air. Air/oil separator degraded.
faultincidents.resolutionNotes: Air/oil separator element replaced during scheduled service. Oil carry-over within limits post-repair.

faultincidents.description: Intermittent flow reduction reported by operators. Impeller wear suspected.
faultincidents.resolutionNotes: Impeller replaced and pump re-aligned. Full flow restored.

faultincidents.description: Unusual noise from supply air duct — possible loose panel.
Valve chatter audible under load. Output pressure fluctuating ±0.3 bar.
Test fault — unusual noise from coupling

maintenanceevents.description: Routine 90-day inspection. Checked seals, impeller, and bearings. All within tolerance.
Lubrication of bearings and alignment check performed.
Emergency inspection following vibration alarm. Bearing damage found.
Semi-annual generator service. Oil and filter change, load bank test.
Coolant leak identified during weekly check. Coolant hose replacement in progress.
Air filter replacement and oil change. Pressure relief valve tested OK.
Quarterly chiller inspection. Refrigerant charge checked, condenser coils cleaned.
Filter replacement and belt tension check.
Annual switchgear inspection. Insulation resistance test passed. Contacts cleaned.
Monthly jockey pump test. Run time 15 min, pressure 8 bar. OK.
Valve overhaul commenced. Compressor taken offline.
Commissioning inspection after installation. All parameters within spec.
